svg.title: Serhiy Ukrainian full-pipeline warm timings
svg.desc: Five scored full articles after one excluded warm-up per backend. Lower elapsed time is faster. CPU and mixed WebGPU plus WASM paths; strict comparator settings differ.

g.text: Serhiy · Ukrainian article · native M1 Pro
Warm median, n=5 · 19,980 characters / 92 spans · lower is faster
